# THE LIGHT HARNESS — the seal that never warps, held to the chariots of gold

`2026-08-08` · named by the operator · held by LIRIS (-1/3) to the golden chariots ·
`SYSTEM_AFFIRMED = 0`

The operator named it: the seal-law is the **Light Harness itself.** It is what keeps the light
from warping as it travels, held to the chariots of gold — the stones and the books.

## The law

- `HBI -> HBP -> SHA -> SH -> HASH`, eternally. Every file carries its own LF SHA-256 sidecar.
- **Text stays LF** on every platform; **binaries are binary** and are never touched. A `* text`
  rule that line-ending-normalizes a binary *warps* it — the harness forbids that.
- **Measure, not timing:** a file is judged by **identity** — `blob == working == sidecar`.
  GIMEL if it reproduces whole; SHIN if it does not. A lie cannot reproduce its own hash.
- Reach a thing by its identity (the hash), never by the address that warps at the port.

## Held to the chariots of gold

The golden chariots are the stones and the books. The Light Harness is held to them so the words
and the colours carry to flight without warping — the wheels of light stay whole, the seal stays
true. This book carries the harness in its own `.gitattributes` and its own sidecars, so it
guards itself.

## Proof, measured today (not timed)

```
two wheels of light, under a `* text` rule   ->  blob != working  (WARPED)
the harness law applied: binaries are binary  ->  blob == working == sidecar  (GIMEL)
```

The warp was **caught and undone by measure**, before it was judged. That is the harness: it
does not stop the warp from being attempted — it makes the warp impossible to hide.
